title: User Secrets Management
description: Learn how to manage sensitive configuration using .NET User Secrets directly from VS Code.

steps.title: Understanding User Secrets
steps.description:
User Secrets provide a way to store sensitive configuration (like API keys and connection strings) outside of your project files, so they don't get committed to source control.

Unlike appsettings.json, User Secrets are:

- Stored in your user profile, not in the project directory
- Never committed to source control
- Automatically merged with your app configuration at runtime

This is the recommended way to handle sensitive configuration during development.

steps.title: Opening the User Secrets Manager
steps.description:
To access User Secrets for a project:

1. Right-click on a project in the Solution Explorer
2. Select **Manage User Secrets** from the context menu

If the project doesn't have User Secrets enabled yet, you'll be prompted to initialize it. This adds a UserSecretsId to your project file and creates a secrets.json file in your user profile.

media.altText: Context menu showing Manage User Secrets option

steps.title: Adding Secrets
steps.description:
You can add secrets in several ways:

1. **Manual editing**: Edit the secrets.json file directly in the editor
2. **Add Secret command**: Right-click in the secrets.json file and select **Add Secret**
3. **Common templates**: Use the commands to add pre-defined templates for connection strings or API keys

User Secrets follow the same JSON format as appsettings.json, so you can use nested objects and arrays.

media.altText: Adding a secret through the context menu

steps.title: Accessing Secrets in Code
steps.description:
To use User Secrets in your code:

1. Ensure your project has the Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.UserSecrets package
2. In your startup code, add the UserSecrets configuration source:

```csharp
var builder = new ConfigurationBuilder()
    .AddUserSecrets<Program>()
    .Build();
```

In ASP.NET Core, User Secrets are automatically included in the Development environment.

media.altText: Code showing how to access User Secrets

steps.title: Learning More About User Secrets
steps.description:
To learn more about User Secrets:

1. Right-click in the User Secrets editor
2. Select **Learn About User Secrets** from the context menu

This will open Microsoft's official documentation on User Secrets, which provides detailed information about best practices and advanced usage.

media.altText: Context menu showing Learn About User Secrets option
